Multiple headings create multiple Heading nodes with correct levels

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"include_document_structure\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<h1>Main Title</h1><h2>Section One</h2><p>Section one content.</p><h2>Section Two</h2><p>Section two content.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.document()?.nodes() as Any)
```
